description: This header file provides utility functions for operating on graph nodes within the 'torch::nativert' namespace, specifically a function to check if all input/output tensors and device attributes for a Node are on CPU.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Forward declaration of the Node class used in graph manipulations.

methods.name: areAllIOTensorsAttributesOnCpu
methods.description: Checks whether all input/output tensors and device-type attributes of a given Node are set to CPU, indicating suitability for static CPU kernel dispatch.
